meta.basis: 'On the altar itself may be placed a Book of the Gospels distinct from the book of other readings' (GIRM 117); it is carried 'slightly elevated' in the Entrance Procession and to the ambo, and kissed after the Gospel (GIRM 120d, 133–134, 173, 175). It should be 'truly worthy, dignified, and beautiful' (GIRM 349). A gilded, jeweled cover with the cross and the four Evangelists' symbols is a traditional form the norms allow. The excerpt is the first verse of Mark, the Gospel of the Second Sunday of Advent, Year B.
